purpose: Independent practice of C3.1 (read IF-THEN statements).
student_learning_goal: I can read an IF-THEN statement and explain what it means.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can read an IF-THEN statement and explain what it means.
header.character_watermark: Inspector If in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Underline the IF (condition) and circle the THEN (action) in each statement.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Six statement rows.

image_placeholders.description: Six IF-THEN statements in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Pre-printed: 'IF it rains, THEN take an umbrella.', 'IF the number is even, THEN clap.', 'IF it is sunny, THEN wear a hat.', 'IF count > 5, THEN say BIG.', 'IF the day is Monday, THEN math class.', 'IF the score is 10, THEN cheer.'. Header 'Find IF and THEN:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P1_FIND: keywords (if, then) name what the rows ask for.

parts.answer_key: Each IF clause underlined; each THEN clause circled.

parts.student_instructions: For each IF-THEN with the given input, decide if the condition is TRUE or FALSE. Circle one.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four IF-THEN rows with TRUE/FALSE bubbles.

image_placeholders.description: Four IF-THEN rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each row: statement + input + TRUE/FALSE bubbles. Pre-printed: '1. IF >5, THEN BIG. Input 7. (TRUE / FALSE)', '2. IF even, THEN clap. Input 9. (TRUE / FALSE)', '3. IF =10, THEN star. Input 10. (TRUE / FALSE)', '4. IF <3, THEN small. Input 5. (TRUE / FALSE)'. Header 'TRUE or FALSE:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P2_TF: keywords (true, false) name the bubbles.

parts.student_instructions: Write 3 of your own IF-THEN statements. Pick any condition and action.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Three numbered IF-THEN slots.

image_placeholders.description: Three numbered IF-THEN slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each slot has '1.', '2.', '3.' on the left with 'IF ___, THEN ___.'. Header 'My IF-THEN Statements:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_OWN: keywords (statements) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each statement must be a valid IF-THEN.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and trace each other's statements with TRUE/FALSE inputs.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 worksheet introduces C3.1 (IF-THEN). Watch for the always-true trap — children who say TRUE for every input. Part 2 uses two UNFAMILIAR transfer conditions ('IF the day ends in y, THEN smile') alongside the familiar ones, to verify gating generalises beyond the lesson examples — flag this for teachers to watch for over-generalisation.
